True False 5
True True 3
True False
0 4
True True 1

title.en: Kruskal with union-find
title.zh: 用并查集做 Kruskal

prompt.en:
Kruskal's algorithm builds a minimum spanning tree of an undirected graph with six vertices. The program sorts the edges by weight, then looks at them one by one. It uses a union-find structure without any tricks: `find` just walks to the root.

For each edge in the order it is examined, fill in whether its two ends were already in the same component, whether the edge is taken or skipped, the total weight of the taken edges so far, and the number of components after this edge. The row label shows the edge and its weight. Use `yes` or `no`, and `take` or `skip`. The first row is filled in.
prompt.zh:
Kruskal 算法在一个有六个顶点的无向图上构造最小生成树。程序先把边按权值排序，再逐条检查。它用的是最朴素的并查集：`find` 只是一路走到根。

按检查的先后顺序，为每条边填写：它的两个端点此前是否已在同一个连通分量里，这条边是被选用还是被跳过，到目前为止选用的边的总权值，以及处理完这条边之后的连通分量个数。行标签给出了这条边和它的权值。请用 `yes` 或 `no`，以及 `take` 或 `skip`。第一行已经填好。

solution.en:
Sorted by weight the edges are B-C 1, D-E 2, A-C 3, A-B 4, C-D 5, B-D 6, E-F 7, C-E 8, D-F 9.

B-C, D-E and A-C each join two different components, so they are taken (components 5, 4, 3; total 1, 3, 6). A-B comes next. A, B and C are already one component, so taking it would close a cycle: skip. C-D joins {A,B,C} with {D,E}: take (total 11, components 2). B-D is inside one component now: skip. E-F brings in the last vertex F: take (total 18, components 1).

C-E and D-F are skipped because everything is already connected. The tree has 5 edges for 6 vertices, with weight 1 + 2 + 3 + 5 + 7 = 18. A skip always means the two ends have the same root.
solution.zh:
按权值排序后，边依次是 B-C 1、D-E 2、A-C 3、A-B 4、C-D 5、B-D 6、E-F 7、C-E 8、D-F 9。

B-C、D-E、A-C 每条都连接了两个不同的分量，所以都被选用（分量数依次为 5、4、3，总权值依次为 1、3、6）。接着是 A-B。A、B、C 已经在同一个分量里，选它会形成环，所以跳过。C-D 把 {A,B,C} 和 {D,E} 连起来，选用（总权值 11，分量数 2）。B-D 现在在同一个分量内部，跳过。E-F 带进了最后一个顶点 F，选用（总权值 18，分量数 1）。

C-E 和 D-F 因为所有顶点已经连通而被跳过。这棵树用 5 条边连接 6 个顶点，权值为 1 + 2 + 3 + 5 + 7 = 18。凡是被跳过的边，它的两个端点必定有相同的根。

title.en: The cut property
title.zh: 割性质

prompt.en:
G is a connected, undirected graph with edge weights. S is a set of vertices that is neither empty nor all of V. Among the edges that cross between S and V \ S, one edge e is strictly lighter than every other crossing edge.

Which statement is guaranteed?
prompt.zh:
G 是带边权的连通无向图。S 是一个顶点集合，既不是空集，也不是全部顶点 V。在连接 S 与 V \ S 的边中，有一条边 e 严格比其他所有跨越边都轻。

下面哪个说法一定成立？

text.en: e is in every minimum spanning tree of G.
text.zh: e 属于 G 的每一棵最小生成树。

why.en: Take any spanning tree T without e. Adding e makes a cycle, and that cycle crosses the cut again at another edge f. Since e is strictly lighter than f, swapping f for e gives a lighter tree, so T was not minimum.
why.zh: 取任何一棵不含 e 的生成树 T。加入 e 会形成一个环，这个环必定还会通过另一条跨越边 f 再次穿过这个割。因为 e 严格比 f 轻，把 f 换成 e 就得到更轻的树，所以 T 不是最小的。

text.en: e is in some minimum spanning tree, but a different one may avoid it.
text.zh: e 属于某一棵最小生成树，但别的最小生成树可能不含它。

why.en: That would be true if another crossing edge were as light as e. Here e is strictly lightest, so no minimum tree can avoid it.
why.zh: 如果另有一条跨越边与 e 一样轻，这句话才可能成立。这里 e 严格最轻，所以没有哪棵最小生成树能避开它。

text.en: e is the lightest edge in the whole graph.
text.zh: e 是整个图中最轻的边。

why.en: It is only the lightest across this one cut. Edges inside S or inside V \ S can be lighter.
why.zh: 它只是这一个割上最轻的边。S 内部或 V \ S 内部的边可能更轻。

text.en: e is in no minimum spanning tree if it lies on a cycle.
text.zh: 如果 e 在某个环上，它就不属于任何最小生成树。

why.en: Being on a cycle does not exclude an edge. Only the heaviest edge of a cycle can be excluded, and any cycle through e crosses the cut again at a heavier edge, so e is never the heaviest edge of a cycle.
why.zh: 在环上并不意味着被排除。能被排除的只有环上最重的边，而经过 e 的任何环都会在一条更重的边处再次穿过这个割，所以 e 永远不是环上最重的边。

title.en: When largest-coin-first fails
title.zh: 什么时候“先取最大面值”会出错

prompt.en:
A shop has coins of value 1, 3 and 4. To pay an amount exactly, a greedy cashier repeatedly takes the largest coin that does not exceed what is left.

For which amount does the greedy cashier use more coins than the smallest possible number?
prompt.zh:
一家商店有面值 1、3、4 的硬币。为了凑出恰好的金额，贪心的收银员每次都拿不超过剩余金额的最大面值的硬币。

对下面哪个金额，贪心的收银员用的硬币数比最少的硬币数多？

why.en: Greedy takes 4 + 1, two coins. No pair or single coin gives 5 in fewer than two coins, so greedy is optimal here.
why.zh: 贪心取 4 + 1，两枚硬币。没有一枚硬币能凑成 5，所以两枚已是最少，贪心在这里是最优的。

why.en: Greedy takes 4, then 1, then 1: three coins. But 3 + 3 uses only two coins. Taking the biggest coin first locks in the 4, which does not fit well into 6.
why.zh: 贪心先取 4，再取 1，再取 1：三枚硬币。可是 3 + 3 只用两枚。先取最大面值把 4 锁定了，而 4 并不适合凑 6。

why.en: Greedy takes 4 + 3, two coins, and that is the minimum.
why.zh: 贪心取 4 + 3，两枚硬币，这已经是最少的。

why.en: Greedy takes 4 + 4, two coins, and that is the minimum.
why.zh: 贪心取 4 + 4，两枚硬币，这已经是最少的。

solution.en: A greedy rule needs a proof. For these coins no exchange argument works: replacing the first 4 in an optimal solution by something else can be cheaper, as the amount 6 shows (3 + 3). A single counterexample is enough to reject the rule.
solution.zh: 贪心规则需要证明。对这些面值，交换论证行不通：把最优解中的第一个 4 换成别的东西反而可能更省，金额 6（3 + 3）就是例子。只要有一个反例，就足以否定这条规则。

title.en: Fewest routers on a street
title.zh: 沿街放最少的路由器

prompt.en:
Leon's village has one long straight street. There are n houses at positions x1, x2, ..., xn along it (real numbers, in any order, repeats allowed). A Wi-Fi router placed at position p serves every house whose position is within distance r of p. The number r > 0 is given. A router may be placed at any real position.

Design an algorithm that places the fewest routers so that every house is served. Describe the algorithm. Prove that it is correct, using an exchange argument. Give its running time.
prompt.zh:
Leon 所在的村子只有一条笔直的长街。街上有 n 座房子，位置是 x1, x2, ..., xn（实数，顺序任意，允许重复）。放在位置 p 的 Wi-Fi 路由器，可以覆盖所有与 p 的距离不超过 r 的房子。r > 0 是已知的数。路由器可以放在任意实数位置。

请设计一个算法，用最少的路由器覆盖所有房子。请描述算法，并用交换论证证明它是正确的，再给出它的运行时间。

solution.en:
Algorithm.
1. Sort the positions in increasing order.
2. Start with i = 1 and an empty list of routers.
3. While i <= n: put a router at p = x_i + r. This is the farthest right a router can sit and still serve x_i, the leftmost house not yet served. Then move i forward past every house with position at most p + r. All of those houses are served by this router.
4. Return the list of routers.

Correctness.
Every house is served: a house is skipped only when its position is at most p + r. It is also at least x_i = p - r, because the positions are sorted. So it lies within r of p.

The count is the smallest possible. Let H be any set of houses and let x be its leftmost house. Let g = x + r, and let H' be the houses of H that lie beyond g + r (the ones that the router g does not serve).
Exchange step: take any valid solution S for H. Some router o of S serves x, so o <= x + r = g. Replace o by g. Every house that o served lies in [x, o + r], because no house is left of x. And [x, o + r] is inside [x, g + r], because o <= g. So g serves all the houses that o served. The new solution S' is valid and has the same number of routers. So some optimal solution contains the router g.
In S', the router g serves no house of H', so the other routers of S' serve all of H'. Hence OPT(H) >= 1 + OPT(H').
Now use induction on the number of houses. The algorithm uses one router g and then solves H' in the same way, so it uses 1 + Greedy(H') routers. By the induction hypothesis (H' has fewer houses) Greedy(H') = OPT(H'). So Greedy(H) = 1 + OPT(H') <= OPT(H). The algorithm's output is valid, so it cannot use fewer than OPT(H). Hence Greedy(H) = OPT(H).

Running time. Sorting takes O(n log n). The loop moves i forward only, so each house is passed once: O(n). In total O(n log n), or O(n) if the positions are already sorted.
solution.zh:
算法。
1. 把位置按从小到大排序。
2. 令 i = 1，路由器列表为空。
3. 当 i <= n 时：把一个路由器放在 p = x_i + r。这是一个路由器在仍能覆盖 x_i（最左边那个还没被覆盖的房子）的前提下可以放得最靠右的位置。然后让 i 向前越过所有位置不超过 p + r 的房子，这些房子都被这个路由器覆盖了。
4. 返回路由器列表。

正确性。
每座房子都被覆盖：一座房子被跳过，只可能是因为它的位置不超过 p + r。又因为位置已排序，它的位置至少是 x_i = p - r。所以它与 p 的距离不超过 r。

路由器的个数是最少的。设 H 是任意一组房子，x 是其中最靠左的房子。令 g = x + r，并令 H' 为 H 中位置超过 g + r 的房子（也就是路由器 g 覆盖不到的那些）。
交换步骤：取 H 的任意一个合法方案 S。S 中有某个路由器 o 覆盖了 x，所以 o <= x + r = g。把 o 换成 g。因为没有房子在 x 的左边，o 覆盖的每座房子都落在 [x, o + r] 里；又因为 o <= g，[x, o + r] 包含在 [x, g + r] 里。所以 g 覆盖了 o 原来覆盖的所有房子。新方案 S' 仍然合法，路由器个数不变。因此存在一个包含路由器 g 的最优方案。
在 S' 中，路由器 g 不覆盖 H' 里的任何房子，所以 S' 中其余的路由器覆盖了 H' 的全部房子。于是 OPT(H) >= 1 + OPT(H')。
再对房子的个数用归纳法。算法先放一个路由器 g，然后用同样的方法处理 H'，所以它用 1 + Greedy(H') 个路由器。由归纳假设（H' 的房子更少）有 Greedy(H') = OPT(H')。所以 Greedy(H) = 1 + OPT(H') <= OPT(H)。算法的输出是合法的，所以不可能少于 OPT(H)。因此 Greedy(H) = OPT(H)。

运行时间。排序需要 O(n log n)。循环里 i 只向前移动，每座房子只被经过一次：O(n)。总共 O(n log n)；如果位置本来就已排好序，则是 O(n)。

text.en: Sorts the positions first.
text.zh: 先把位置排序。

text.en: Takes the leftmost house that is not yet served, x, and places a router at x + r (not at x).
text.zh: 取最左边尚未被覆盖的房子 x，把路由器放在 x + r（而不是放在 x）。

text.en: Skips every house up to x + 2r and repeats until no house is left.
text.zh: 跳过所有位置不超过 x + 2r 的房子，重复直到没有房子剩下。

text.en: Shows that the output serves every house.
text.zh: 说明输出覆盖了每一座房子。

text.en: Exchange setup: in any solution some router o serves the leftmost house x, so o <= x + r.
text.zh: 交换的起点：任何方案中都有某个路由器 o 覆盖最左的房子 x，所以 o <= x + r。

text.en: Shows that moving o to x + r keeps every house that o served served, because no house lies left of x, so an optimal solution contains the greedy router.
text.zh: 说明把 o 移到 x + r 之后，o 原来覆盖的房子仍被覆盖（因为 x 左边没有房子），所以存在包含贪心路由器的最优方案。

text.en: Uses induction on the houses beyond x + 2r: the optimum needs one router for x plus the optimum for the rest, so greedy equals the optimum.
text.zh: 对 x + 2r 之外的房子用归纳法：最优解为 x 用一个路由器，其余部分再用最优解，所以贪心等于最优。

text.en: Sorting costs O(n log n).
text.zh: 排序的代价是 O(n log n)。

text.en: The scan passes each house once, so it costs O(n).
text.zh: 扫描时每座房子只经过一次，所以代价是 O(n)。

text.en: States the total, O(n log n), and that sorting dominates.
text.zh: 给出总代价 O(n log n)，并指出排序起主导作用。

mistakes.en: Placing the router at the house x itself instead of x + r: the left half of its range then covers nobody.
mistakes.zh: 把路由器放在房子 x 本身而不是 x + r：这样它覆盖范围的左半边没有覆盖到任何房子。

mistakes.en: Saying "this choice covers the most houses, so it is optimal" without an exchange argument or any proof.
mistakes.zh: 只说“这样选覆盖的房子最多，所以最优”，却没有交换论证或任何证明。

mistakes.en: Forgetting to sort the positions, so that the "leftmost unserved house" is not well defined.
mistakes.zh: 没有先排序，于是“最左边尚未被覆盖的房子”没有明确的含义。

mistakes.en: Claiming O(n²) because of two nested loops. The inner loop moves the same index i as the outer loop, so each house is passed once.
mistakes.zh: 因为有两层循环就说是 O(n²)。内层循环和外层循环移动的是同一个下标 i，每座房子只经过一次。

title.en: A counterexample to shortest-first
title.zh: “最短优先”的反例

prompt.en:
Mia has a set of jobs. Each job is a half-open time interval [start, end). Two jobs conflict if their intervals overlap. For example [0, 5) and [5, 8) do not overlap. She wants to choose as many pairwise non-conflicting jobs as possible. She proposes this rule: "Repeatedly take the shortest job that does not conflict with the jobs already taken."

(a) Give a set of three jobs on which the rule does not find the largest possible number of jobs. Say which jobs the rule takes, and give a better choice.
(b) Explain where an exchange argument for this rule breaks down.
(c) Name a rule that does work.
prompt.zh:
Mia 有一组工作。每个工作是一个左闭右开的时间区间 [开始, 结束)。如果两个工作的区间重叠，它们就冲突。例如 [0, 5) 与 [5, 8) 不重叠。她想选出尽可能多、两两不冲突的工作。她提出这样一条规则：“反复选取与已选工作不冲突的最短的工作。”

(a) 给出一个含三个工作的例子，使这条规则找不到最多的工作数。说明规则会选哪些工作，并给出一个更好的选法。
(b) 解释针对这条规则的交换论证在哪里行不通。
(c) 说出一条真正有效的规则。

solution.en:
(a) Take X = [0, 5), Y = [4, 7) and Z = [6, 11). The lengths are 5, 3 and 5. The rule takes Y first, because it is the shortest. X overlaps Y (4 < 5), and Z overlaps Y (6 < 7). So nothing else can be taken, and the rule returns {Y}: one job. But X and Z do not overlap (X ends at 5 and Z starts at 6), so {X, Z} is a valid choice of two jobs. The rule is not optimal.

(b) An exchange argument would start from an optimal solution and swap one of its jobs for the job the rule picks, without making the solution smaller or creating a conflict. Here the optimal solution is {X, Z}, and Y conflicts with both X and Z. Putting Y in forces us to remove both of them, and we lose a job. A short job can block several longer jobs that fit together, so the swap does not work.

(c) Choose the job with the earliest end time among the jobs that do not conflict with those already taken. On the example it takes X (it ends at 5), then Z (it starts at 6, which is at least 5), for two jobs. Its exchange argument works: in any optimal solution, replace the job that ends first by the job with the earliest end time overall. That job ends no later, so it conflicts with none of the other jobs, and the solution keeps the same size.
solution.zh:
(a) 取 X = [0, 5)，Y = [4, 7)，Z = [6, 11)。它们的长度分别是 5、3、5。规则先选 Y，因为它最短。X 与 Y 重叠（4 < 5），Z 与 Y 也重叠（6 < 7）。所以再也不能选别的工作，规则返回 {Y}：只有一个工作。但是 X 与 Z 不重叠（X 在 5 结束，Z 在 6 开始），所以 {X, Z} 是一个合法的两个工作的选法。这条规则不是最优的。

(b) 交换论证会从一个最优解出发，把其中的一个工作换成规则选出的那个工作，同时不让解变小，也不产生冲突。这里最优解是 {X, Z}，而 Y 同时与 X 和 Z 冲突。放入 Y 就必须同时去掉它们两个，于是少了一个工作。一个短的工作可能挡住好几个本来能放在一起的较长的工作，所以这种交换行不通。

(c) 在与已选工作不冲突的工作中，选择结束时间最早的那个。在这个例子里，它先选 X（在 5 结束），再选 Z（在 6 开始，不早于 5），共两个工作。它的交换论证是成立的：在任何最优解中，把结束得最早的那个工作换成整体上结束时间最早的工作。后者结束得不晚，所以不会与其他工作冲突，解的大小不变。

text.en: Gives a valid instance of at least three intervals and respects the half-open convention.
text.zh: 给出至少含三个区间的合法例子，并遵守左闭右开的约定。

text.en: States correctly which job(s) the shortest-first rule takes on the instance, and that it stops there.
text.zh: 正确说明“最短优先”规则在这个例子里选了哪些工作，并且在那里就停止了。

text.en: Gives a better conflict-free choice and checks that its jobs do not overlap.
text.zh: 给出一个更好的、不冲突的选法，并检查其中的工作互不重叠。

text.en: Explains that the shortest job can conflict with two jobs of an optimal solution, so swapping it in removes two jobs and the exchange argument fails.
text.zh: 解释最短的工作可能与最优解中的两个工作冲突，换入它就要去掉两个工作，所以交换论证失败。

text.en: Names earliest end time first as a rule that works.
text.zh: 指出“最早结束优先”是一条有效的规则。

mistakes.en: Giving intervals where the rule happens to work, for example when the shortest job overlaps nothing.
mistakes.zh: 给出的例子恰好能让这条规则成功，例如最短的工作与其他工作都不重叠。

mistakes.en: Treating [0, 5) and [5, 8) as overlapping, which changes which sets are valid.
mistakes.zh: 把 [0, 5) 与 [5, 8) 当作重叠，这会改变哪些选法是合法的。

mistakes.en: Saying "the rule is wrong" without showing both what it picks and a larger valid choice.
mistakes.zh: 只说“这条规则不对”，却没有同时给出它的选择和一个更大的合法选法。

mistakes.en: Trying to repair an exchange argument by saying the shortest job "fits somewhere", without checking its conflicts with the other jobs.
mistakes.zh: 想通过说最短的工作“总能放进去”来补救交换论证，却没有检查它与其他工作的冲突。

title.en: Binary search for a boundary
title.zh: 用二分查找找边界

prompt.en:
Write `first_at_least(a, x)`.

`a` is a list of integers sorted in non-decreasing order. It may contain repeated values. Return the smallest index `i` with `a[i] >= x`. If every item is smaller than `x`, return `len(a)`.

Use binary search, so the loop reads O(log n) items. Do not scan the list from the left, and do not use the `bisect` module.
prompt.zh:
编写函数 `first_at_least(a, x)`。

`a` 是按非递减顺序排好的整数列表，里面可能有重复的值。请返回满足 `a[i] >= x` 的最小下标 `i`。如果所有元素都比 `x` 小，就返回 `len(a)`。

要求使用二分查找，让循环只读取 O(log n) 个元素。不要从左到右逐个扫描，也不要使用 `bisect` 模块。

text.en: Starts with `lo = 0` and `hi = len(a)`, so the answer `len(a)` is possible.
text.zh: 初始 `lo = 0`、`hi = len(a)`，这样答案 `len(a)` 也是可能的结果。

text.en: Loops while `lo < hi` and takes `mid = (lo + hi) // 2` (integer division).
text.zh: 循环条件是 `lo < hi`，并用整除求 `mid = (lo + hi) // 2`。

text.en: If `a[mid] < x`, moves to `lo = mid + 1`.
text.zh: 若 `a[mid] < x`，则令 `lo = mid + 1`。

text.en: Otherwise sets `hi = mid`, keeping `mid` as a possible answer.
text.zh: 否则令 `hi = mid`，保留 `mid` 作为可能的答案。

text.en: Returns `lo`; the empty list and the "all items smaller" case both work.
text.zh: 最后返回 `lo`；空列表和“所有元素都更小”的情况都能得到正确结果。

text.en: Says the range halves each round, so there are O(log n) reads.
text.zh: 说明每轮范围减半，所以只读取 O(log n) 个元素。

mistakes.en: Starting with `hi = len(a) - 1` means the answer `len(a)` can never be returned.
mistakes.zh: 把 `hi` 设为 `len(a) - 1`，会导致永远返回不了答案 `len(a)`。

mistakes.en: Writing `lo = mid` instead of `lo = mid + 1` can loop forever when `hi = lo + 1`.
mistakes.zh: 写成 `lo = mid` 而不是 `lo = mid + 1`，当 `hi = lo + 1` 时可能死循环。

mistakes.en: Using `/` instead of `//` gives a float, and a float cannot index a list.
mistakes.zh: 用 `/` 而不是 `//` 会得到小数，而小数不能当列表下标。

mistakes.en: Testing `a[mid] <= x` finds a position after the repeated values instead of the first one.
mistakes.zh: 判断写成 `a[mid] <= x`，找到的是重复值之后的位置，而不是第一个位置。

mistakes.en: Returning -1 for "not found" when the question asks for `len(a)`.
mistakes.zh: 题目要求返回 `len(a)`，却返回了 -1 表示没找到。

questions.tests:
class Counted(list):
    reads = 0
    def __getitem__(self, i):
        Counted.reads += 1
        return list.__getitem__(self, i)

print(first_at_least([], 5))
print(first_at_least([1, 3, 3, 3, 8], 3))
print(first_at_least([1, 3, 3, 3, 8], 4))
print(first_at_least([1, 3, 3, 3, 8], 0))
print(first_at_least([1, 3, 3, 3, 8], 9))
print(first_at_least([7], 7), first_at_least([7], 8))
big = Counted(range(0, 2000, 2))
print(first_at_least(big, 777), Counted.reads <= 12)

title.en: Merge two sorted lists
title.zh: 合并两个有序列表

prompt.en:
Write `merge(a, b)`.

`a` and `b` are lists sorted in non-decreasing order. Return a new list that holds every item of both lists, in non-decreasing order. When an item of `a` equals an item of `b`, the item of `a` must come first.

Do not call `sorted` or `list.sort`. Do not change `a` or `b`. The time must be O(len(a) + len(b)).
prompt.zh:
编写函数 `merge(a, b)`。

`a` 和 `b` 都是按非递减顺序排好的列表。请返回一个新列表，包含两个列表的全部元素，并且按非递减顺序排列。当 `a` 中的元素与 `b` 中的元素相等时，`a` 的元素必须排在前面。

不要调用 `sorted` 或 `list.sort`，也不要修改 `a` 和 `b`，时间必须是 O(len(a) + len(b))。

questions.model_code:
def merge(a, b):
    out = []
    i = j = 0
    while i < len(a) and j < len(b):
        if b[j] < a[i]:             # strictly smaller: take from b; ties go to a
            out.append(b[j])
            j += 1
        else:
            out.append(a[i])
            i += 1
    out.extend(a[i:])               # at most one of these two is not empty
    out.extend(b[j:])
    return out

text.en: Keeps one index per list, both starting at 0, and loops while both lists still have unused items.
text.zh: 每个列表各用一个下标，都从 0 开始，并在两个列表都还有未用元素时循环。

text.en: Compares the two front items and takes the smaller; on a tie it takes the one from `a`.
text.zh: 比较两个队首元素，取较小者；相等时取 `a` 中的那个。

text.en: Advances only the index of the list it took from.
text.zh: 只让被取走元素所在列表的下标前进。

text.en: After the loop, copies the unused tail of whichever list is left.
text.zh: 循环结束后，把剩下那个列表中未用的尾部复制过去。

text.en: Builds a new list without sorting or changing the inputs; each item is handled once, so O(len(a) + len(b)).
text.zh: 构造新列表，不排序也不改动输入；每个元素只处理一次，所以是 O(len(a) + len(b))。

mistakes.en: Forgetting to copy the leftover tail loses the largest items.
mistakes.zh: 忘记复制剩下的尾部，会丢掉最大的那些元素。

mistakes.en: Taking from `b` on a tie when the question says `a` comes first (it breaks stability).
mistakes.zh: 相等时取了 `b` 的元素，而题目要求 `a` 在前（这样会破坏稳定性）。

mistakes.en: Using `a.pop(0)` in the loop makes each step O(n) and changes the input.
mistakes.zh: 在循环里用 `a.pop(0)`，每步是 O(n)，还会改动输入。

mistakes.en: Looping with `while i < len(a) or j < len(b)` without a guard reads past the end of one list.
mistakes.zh: 用 `while i < len(a) or j < len(b)` 却不加保护，会读到某个列表的末尾之外。

questions.tests:
class K:
    def __init__(self, k, tag):
        self.k, self.tag = k, tag
    def __lt__(self, o): return self.k < o.k
    def __le__(self, o): return self.k <= o.k
    def __gt__(self, o): return self.k > o.k
    def __ge__(self, o): return self.k >= o.k
    def __repr__(self): return f"{self.k}{self.tag}"

print(merge([1, 4, 9], [2, 3, 10, 11]))
print(merge([], [5, 6]), merge([5, 6], []), merge([], []))
print(merge([1, 1, 2], [1, 2, 2]))
x = [K(1, 'a'), K(2, 'a'), K(2, 'a2')]
y = [K(1, 'b'), K(2, 'b')]
print(merge(x, y))
p, q = [3, 5], [4]
merge(p, q)
print(p, q)

title.en: Evaluate a recurrence
title.zh: 计算一个递推式的值

prompt.en:
Define T(1) = 1 and, for n a power of 2 greater than 1, T(n) = 2T(n/2) + n².

What is T(32)?
prompt.zh:
设 T(1) = 1，并且当 n 是大于 1 的 2 的幂时，T(n) = 2T(n/2) + n²。

T(32) 等于多少？

solution.en:
Build the values from the bottom. T(1) = 1. T(2) = 2 x 1 + 4 = 6. T(4) = 2 x 6 + 16 = 28. T(8) = 2 x 28 + 64 = 120. T(16) = 2 x 120 + 256 = 496. T(32) = 2 x 496 + 1024 = 2016.

Check with the closed form T(n) = 2n² - n: for n = 32 it is 2048 - 32 = 2016. The top level (n² = 1024) is about half of the total, because the work per level halves going down: n², n²/2, n²/4, ... This is the "local work dominates" case of the master theorem.

title.en: Counting flipped pairs
title.zh: 数“翻倍逆序对”

prompt.en:
Mia has a list a[0..n-1] of integers. A pair of positions (i, j) is called flipped if i < j and a[i] > 2 * a[j]. Counting flipped pairs with two nested loops takes Θ(n²) time.

Design a divide-and-conquer algorithm that counts the flipped pairs in O(n log n) time. Describe it, prove it correct, and analyse its running time. You may use the standard linear-time merge of two sorted lists.
prompt.zh:
Mia 有一个整数列表 a[0..n-1]。如果一对位置 (i, j) 满足 i < j 并且 a[i] > 2 * a[j]，就称它是“翻倍逆序对”。用两层循环去数这样的对，需要 Θ(n²) 的时间。

请设计一个分治算法，在 O(n log n) 时间内数出翻倍逆序对的个数。请描述算法，证明它正确，并分析它的运行时间。你可以直接使用把两个有序列表合并起来的标准线性时间归并。

solution.en:
Idea. Run merge sort. While the two halves are sorted but not yet merged, count the flipped pairs that cross the middle.

Algorithm COUNT(A, lo, hi). It sorts A[lo..hi-1] and returns the number of flipped pairs inside that range.
1. If hi - lo <= 1, return 0.
2. mid = (lo + hi) / 2, rounded down. c = COUNT(A, lo, mid) + COUNT(A, mid, hi). Now both halves are sorted.
3. Cross pairs. Set p = lo. For j = mid, mid + 1, ..., hi - 1, in this order: while p < mid and A[p] <= 2 * A[j], increase p by one; then add mid - p to c. (Every entry of the left half from position p on is larger than 2 * A[j].)
4. Merge the sorted halves A[lo..mid-1] and A[mid..hi-1] into one sorted range.
5. Return c.
The answer is COUNT(A, 0, n).

Correctness.
Take a range and a flipped pair (i, j) inside it. Then i < j, so there are three disjoint kinds: both positions in the left half, both in the right half, or i in the left half and j in the right half. (i in the right half and j in the left half is impossible.)
We show by induction on the length of the range that COUNT returns the number of flipped pairs of the range, counted in the original order, and leaves the range sorted. A range of length at most 1 has no pairs. For longer ranges, the induction hypothesis gives the number of pairs of the first two kinds (they are the recursive counts) and sorted halves.
The third kind depends only on which values are in the left half and which are in the right half, because every left position is before every right position. Sorting the halves does not change these two collections of values, so we may count with the sorted halves.
Fix j in the right half. The left values larger than 2 * A[j] are exactly a suffix of the sorted left half. It starts at the first position p_j with A[p_j] > 2 * A[j], so there are mid - p_j of them. As j moves right through the sorted right half, A[j] does not decrease, so 2 * A[j] does not decrease, so p_j does not decrease. Therefore one pointer p that only moves right finds all the p_j. Step 3 adds mid - p_j for every j, which is the number of pairs of the third kind.
The counting must happen before step 4, because after the merge the two halves are mixed. Step 4 leaves the range sorted, as the caller needs. This completes the induction.

Running time. In step 3, j visits n/2 positions and p moves at most n/2 positions, so it takes O(n). The merge takes O(n). So T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n) and T(1) = O(1). By the master theorem (a = 2, b = 2, local work Θ(n), the equal case) T(n) = Θ(n log n). The merge needs O(n) extra space.
solution.zh:
思路。运行归并排序。在两个半区已经分别排好序、但还没有合并的时候，数出跨越中点的翻倍逆序对。

算法 COUNT(A, lo, hi)。它把 A[lo..hi-1] 排好序，并返回这个范围内翻倍逆序对的个数。
1. 如果 hi - lo <= 1，返回 0。
2. mid = (lo + hi) / 2（向下取整）。c = COUNT(A, lo, mid) + COUNT(A, mid, hi)。这时两个半区都已排好序。
3. 跨越中点的对。令 p = lo。依次让 j = mid, mid + 1, ..., hi - 1：当 p < mid 并且 A[p] <= 2 * A[j] 时，把 p 加 1；然后把 mid - p 加到 c 上。（左半区从位置 p 开始的每一项都大于 2 * A[j]。）
4. 把有序的两个半区 A[lo..mid-1] 和 A[mid..hi-1] 归并成一个有序的范围。
5. 返回 c。
最终的答案是 COUNT(A, 0, n)。

正确性。
取一个范围，以及其中的一个翻倍逆序对 (i, j)。这时 i < j，所以分成三类，互不相交：两个位置都在左半区；两个位置都在右半区；i 在左半区而 j 在右半区。（i 在右半区而 j 在左半区是不可能的。）
我们对范围的长度用归纳法证明：COUNT 返回的是这个范围里（按原来顺序计算的）翻倍逆序对的个数，并且让这个范围变成有序。长度不超过 1 的范围里没有对。对更长的范围，由归纳假设，两次递归调用的返回值就是前两类对的个数，并且两个半区已排好序。
第三类对只取决于左半区有哪些值、右半区有哪些值，因为每个左边的位置都在每个右边的位置之前。对半区排序不会改变这两组值，所以可以用排好序的半区来数。
固定右半区里的 j。左半区中大于 2 * A[j] 的值恰好是有序左半区的一个后缀，它从第一个满足 A[p_j] > 2 * A[j] 的位置 p_j 开始，所以共有 mid - p_j 个。当 j 在有序的右半区里向右移动时，A[j] 不会减小，所以 2 * A[j] 不会减小，所以 p_j 也不会减小。因此只需要一个只向右移动的指针 p，就能找到所有的 p_j。第 3 步对每个 j 加上 mid - p_j，正是第三类对的个数。
计数必须在第 4 步之前完成，因为归并之后两个半区就混在一起了。第 4 步让范围保持有序，这正是调用者需要的。归纳完成。

运行时间。第 3 步里，j 经过 n/2 个位置，p 最多移动 n/2 个位置，所以是 O(n)。归并是 O(n)。所以 T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n)，T(1) = O(1)。由主定理（a = 2，b = 2，局部工作量 Θ(n)，属于相等的情形）得 T(n) = Θ(n log n)。归并需要 O(n) 的额外空间。

text.en: Splits the range in the middle and recursively counts both halves.
text.zh: 把范围从中间分开，并对两个半区递归地计数。

text.en: Counts the cross pairs with one pointer over the sorted left half while j moves over the sorted right half.
text.zh: 用一个指针扫过有序的左半区、同时让 j 扫过有序的右半区，来数跨越中点的对。

text.en: Merges the halves so that the range comes back sorted.
text.zh: 把两个半区归并，使这个范围返回时是有序的。

text.en: Splits the pairs into three disjoint kinds (left-left, right-right, left-right) and notes that right-left is impossible.
text.zh: 把对分成互不相交的三类（左左、右右、左右），并指出右左是不可能的。

text.en: Uses induction on the length: the recursive calls give the right counts and sorted halves.
text.zh: 对长度用归纳法：递归调用给出正确的计数，并让两个半区有序。

text.en: Notes that cross pairs depend only on the contents of the two halves, so sorting them first does not change the count.
text.zh: 指出跨越中点的对只取决于两个半区各自的内容，所以先排序不会改变个数。

text.en: The left values larger than 2 * A[j] form a suffix of the sorted left half, of size mid - p_j.
text.zh: 左半区中大于 2 * A[j] 的值构成有序左半区的一个后缀，大小为 mid - p_j。

text.en: The pointer never moves left because 2 * A[j] never decreases; and the counting is done before the merge.
text.zh: 因为 2 * A[j] 不会减小，所以指针不会向左移动；并且计数在归并之前完成。

text.en: The cross counting and the merge each take O(n).
text.zh: 跨越中点的计数和归并各自需要 O(n)。

text.en: Writes the recurrence T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n).
text.zh: 写出递推式 T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n)。

text.en: Solves it to Θ(n log n) (master theorem or n work on each of log n levels) and gives O(n) extra space.
text.zh: 解出 Θ(n log n)（主定理，或 log n 层、每层 n 的工作量），并给出 O(n) 的额外空间。

mistakes.en: Counting the cross pairs after the merge, when the two halves are already mixed together.
mistakes.zh: 在归并之后才去数跨越中点的对，那时两个半区已经混在一起了。

mistakes.en: Counting the cross pairs with a nested loop. That costs Θ(n²) at the top level, and the recurrence then solves to Θ(n²).
mistakes.zh: 用两层循环去数跨越中点的对。这在最上层就要 Θ(n²)，递推式会解出 Θ(n²)。

mistakes.en: Trying to count during the merge with the merge pointers. The merge compares A[p] with A[j], but the flipped test compares A[p] with 2 * A[j], so it needs its own pass.
mistakes.zh: 想在归并的同时用归并的指针来数。归并比较的是 A[p] 和 A[j]，而翻倍逆序的判断比较的是 A[p] 和 2 * A[j]，所以需要单独扫一遍。

mistakes.en: Running the pointer over halves that were not sorted first, so that the "suffix" idea is false.
mistakes.zh: 在没有先排序的半区上移动指针，这样“后缀”的说法就不成立了。

questions.verify_code:
import random
random.seed(5)

def count(A, lo, hi):
    """Sorts A[lo:hi] and returns the number of pairs i<j with A[i] > 2*A[j] inside it."""
    if hi - lo <= 1:
        return 0
    mid = (lo + hi) // 2
    c = count(A, lo, mid) + count(A, mid, hi)
    p = lo
    for j in range(mid, hi):
        while p < mid and A[p] <= 2 * A[j]:
            p += 1
        c += mid - p
    A[lo:hi] = sorted(A[lo:mid] + A[mid:hi])      # stands for the usual linear merge
    return c

cases = 0
for _ in range(500):
    n = random.randint(0, 12)
    a = [random.randint(-6, 12) for _ in range(n)]
    want = sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n) if a[i] > 2 * a[j])
    b = a[:]
    assert count(b, 0, n) == want, a
    assert b == sorted(a)
    cases += 1
print('ok', cases)

title.en: Trace a partition step
title.zh: 跟踪一次划分

prompt.en:
This is the partition step of quicksort with the last item as the pivot. The loop keeps `a[0..i]` for items that are at most the pivot.

For each value of `j`, write whether `a[j] <= pivot` is true (`yes` or `no`) *when `a[j]` is looked at*, the value of `i` after that iteration, and the whole list after that iteration (numbers joined by commas, no spaces). The last row is the final swap that puts the pivot in place: write `-` for the test, and give `i` and the list after the swap. The first row is filled in.
prompt.zh:
这是以最后一个元素为枢轴的快速排序划分步骤。循环用 `a[0..i]` 保存不超过枢轴的元素。

对 `j` 的每一个取值，请写出检查 `a[j]` 时 `a[j] <= pivot` 是否成立（`yes` 或 `no`）、这一轮结束后 `i` 的值，以及这一轮结束后的整个列表（数字之间用逗号，不加空格）。最后一行是把枢轴放到位的那次交换：判断一栏写 `-`，并给出交换后的 `i` 和列表。第一行已经填好。

questions.verify_code:
a = [7, 2, 9, 4, 6, 1, 8, 5]
pivot = a[-1]
i = -1

for j in range(len(a) - 1):
    ok = a[j] <= pivot
    if ok:
        i += 1
        a[i], a[j] = a[j], a[i]
    print(f'j={j}\t' + ('yes' if ok else 'no') + f'\t{i}\t' + ','.join(map(str, a)))
a[i + 1], a[-1] = a[-1], a[i + 1]
print(f'swap pivot\t-\t{i}\t' + ','.join(map(str, a)))

solution.en:
The pivot is 5. j = 0: 7 is larger, so nothing changes. j = 1: 2 is small, so i becomes 0 and a[0], a[1] swap: 2,7,9,4,6,1,8,5. j = 2: 9 is large. j = 3: 4 is small, i becomes 1 and a[1], a[3] swap: 2,4,9,7,6,1,8,5. j = 4: 6 is large. j = 5: 1 is small, i becomes 2 and a[2], a[5] swap: 2,4,1,7,6,9,8,5. j = 6: 8 is large.

Now a[0..2] hold the small items, and a[3..6] hold the large ones. The final swap exchanges a[i+1] = a[3] (value 7) with the pivot, giving 2,4,1,5,6,9,8,7. The pivot 5 is at index 3, its final sorted position: everything to its left is at most 5 and everything to its right is larger. The two sides are then sorted recursively.
solution.zh:
枢轴是 5。j = 0：7 比枢轴大，什么也不变。j = 1：2 小，所以 i 变成 0，a[0] 与 a[1] 交换：2,7,9,4,6,1,8,5。j = 2：9 大。j = 3：4 小，i 变成 1，a[1] 与 a[3] 交换：2,4,9,7,6,1,8,5。j = 4：6 大。j = 5：1 小，i 变成 2，a[2] 与 a[5] 交换：2,4,1,7,6,9,8,5。j = 6：8 大。

此时 a[0..2] 里是小元素，a[3..6] 里是大元素。最后一次交换把 a[i+1] = a[3]（值为 7）与枢轴交换，得到 2,4,1,5,6,9,8,7。枢轴 5 在下标 3，这正是它排好序之后的位置：左边都不超过 5，右边都比 5 大。之后再对两边递归排序。

title.en: Counting argument for sorting
title.zh: 排序下界的计数论证

prompt.en:
A comparison-based algorithm sorts 6 distinct numbers, and each comparison has two possible outcomes. The algorithm can be drawn as a binary decision tree whose leaves must cover all possible orders of the input.

By this counting argument, what is the smallest number of comparisons that the algorithm needs in the worst case? (Take the smallest whole number h with 2^h at least the number of orders.)
prompt.zh:
一个基于比较的算法要给 6 个互不相同的数排序，每次比较有两种可能的结果。这个算法可以画成一棵二叉决策树，它的叶子必须覆盖输入的所有可能顺序。

按这个计数论证，该算法在最坏情况下至少需要多少次比较？（取最小的整数 h，使 2^h 不小于所有可能顺序的个数。）

questions.verify_code:
import math
print(math.ceil(math.log2(math.factorial(6))))

solution.en:
Six distinct numbers can come in 6! = 720 orders, and a correct algorithm must reach a different leaf for each. A binary tree of height h has at most 2^h leaves. 2^9 = 512 is below 720, and 2^10 = 1024 is enough. So h must be at least 10.

This is a lower bound from counting, so no comparison-based algorithm can do better in the worst case. The same argument with n numbers gives log2(n!) comparisons, which grows like n log n.
solution.zh:
6 个互不相同的数有 6! = 720 种顺序，正确的算法必须为每一种顺序到达不同的叶子。高度为 h 的二叉树最多有 2^h 个叶子。2^9 = 512 小于 720，而 2^10 = 1024 就够了。所以 h 至少是 10。

这是由计数得到的下界，所以任何基于比较的算法在最坏情况下都不可能做得更好。对 n 个数用同样的论证，得到 log2(n!) 次比较，它的增长量级是 n log n。

title.en: Loop invariant for partition
title.zh: 划分过程的循环不变式

prompt.en:
The function `partition` rearranges A[lo..hi] around the pivot A[hi].

Use a loop invariant to prove this: when the function returns q, every item in A[lo..q-1] is at most the pivot, A[q] is the pivot, and every item in A[q+1..hi] is greater than the pivot. State the invariant. Then prove initialisation, maintenance and termination.
prompt.zh:
函数 `partition` 以 A[hi] 为枢轴，重新排列 A[lo..hi]。

请用循环不变式证明：函数返回 q 时，A[lo..q-1] 中的每个元素都不超过枢轴，A[q] 就是枢轴，A[q+1..hi] 中的每个元素都大于枢轴。请写出循环不变式，然后分别证明初始化、保持和终止。

solution.en:
Let p be the original value of A[hi].

Invariant. At the start of the iteration for index j (and also when the loop ends with j = hi):
(a) every item in A[lo..i] is at most p;
(b) every item in A[i+1..j-1] is greater than p;
(c) A[hi] = p.

Initialisation. At the start j = lo and i = lo - 1. Both A[lo..i] and A[i+1..j-1] are empty, so (a) and (b) hold with no items to check. (c) holds by the definition of p.

Maintenance. Assume the invariant at the start of an iteration with lo <= j < hi. Every swap in the loop uses positions i+1 and j, which are at most j <= hi - 1, so A[hi] never changes: (c) stays true.
- Case A[j] > p. Nothing moves. After j increases by 1, the region A[i+1..j-1] contains the old region and the item A[j], which is greater than p. So (b) holds. (a) is unchanged.
- Case A[j] <= p. First i becomes i + 1, then A[i] and A[j] are swapped. There are two sub-cases. If the old region (b) was empty, then the new i equals j, the swap changes nothing, and A[j] <= p simply joins region (a), while region (b) stays empty. If the old region (b) was not empty, the item at the new position i is the first item of that region, which is greater than p. The swap moves it to position j and brings A[j], which is at most p, to position i. Now (a) holds, because the items of A[lo..i-1] were at most p and the new A[i] is at most p. For (b): the items at positions i+1..j-1 are the old region (b) without its first item, all greater than p, and position j holds the item that moved there, also greater than p. After j increases by 1, A[i+1..j-1] is exactly this set, so (b) holds.

Termination. The loop ends with j = hi. Then the invariant says: A[lo..i] are at most p, A[i+1..hi-1] are greater than p, and A[hi] = p. The last statement swaps A[i+1] and A[hi]. If i + 1 = hi, nothing changes. Otherwise A[i+1], which is greater than p, moves to position hi, and p moves to position i + 1. In both cases we now have A[lo..i] at most p, A[i+1] = p, and A[i+2..hi] greater than p. The function returns q = i + 1, which is exactly the claim. All changes were swaps, so the items are only rearranged, and none is lost or created.
solution.zh:
设 p 是 A[hi] 原来的值。

循环不变式。在下标为 j 的那一轮开始时（以及循环结束、j = hi 时）：
(a) A[lo..i] 中的每个元素都不超过 p；
(b) A[i+1..j-1] 中的每个元素都大于 p；
(c) A[hi] = p。

初始化。开始时 j = lo，i = lo - 1。A[lo..i] 和 A[i+1..j-1] 都是空的，所以 (a) 和 (b) 无需检查任何元素就成立。(c) 由 p 的定义成立。

保持。假设在某一轮开始时（lo <= j < hi）不变式成立。循环中每次交换用到的位置是 i+1 和 j，它们都不超过 j <= hi - 1，所以 A[hi] 从不改变：(c) 仍然成立。
- 情形 A[j] > p。什么都不移动。j 加 1 之后，区域 A[i+1..j-1] 包含原来的区域和元素 A[j]，而 A[j] 大于 p。所以 (b) 成立，(a) 没有变。
- 情形 A[j] <= p。先让 i 变成 i + 1，再交换 A[i] 和 A[j]。分两种子情形。如果原来的区域 (b) 是空的，那么新的 i 等于 j，交换没有改变任何东西，A[j] <= p 只是加入了区域 (a)，而区域 (b) 仍是空的。如果原来的区域 (b) 非空，那么新位置 i 上的元素是该区域的第一个元素，它大于 p。交换把它移到位置 j，并把不超过 p 的 A[j] 带到位置 i。这时 (a) 成立，因为 A[lo..i-1] 里的元素原本就不超过 p，而新的 A[i] 也不超过 p。对于 (b)：位置 i+1..j-1 上的元素是原区域 (b) 去掉第一个元素之后的部分，都大于 p；位置 j 上是被移过去的那个元素，也大于 p。j 加 1 之后，A[i+1..j-1] 正好就是这一组元素，所以 (b) 成立。

终止。循环在 j = hi 时结束。这时不变式说：A[lo..i] 不超过 p，A[i+1..hi-1] 大于 p，A[hi] = p。最后一条语句交换 A[i+1] 和 A[hi]。如果 i + 1 = hi，则什么也不变。否则，大于 p 的 A[i+1] 移到位置 hi，而 p 移到位置 i + 1。两种情形下，现在都是 A[lo..i] 不超过 p，A[i+1] = p，A[i+2..hi] 大于 p。函数返回 q = i + 1，这正是要证明的结论。所有的改动都是交换，所以元素只是被重新排列，没有丢失也没有新增。

text.en: States an invariant that has the two regions with the correct index ranges: A[lo..i] at most p and A[i+1..j-1] greater than p (and A[hi] = p).
text.zh: 写出的不变式包含下标范围正确的两个区域：A[lo..i] 不超过 p，A[i+1..j-1] 大于 p（以及 A[hi] = p）。

text.en: Initialisation: both regions are empty at the start.
text.zh: 初始化：开始时两个区域都是空的。

text.en: Maintenance when A[j] > p: the item joins the "greater" region.
text.zh: 当 A[j] > p 时的保持：该元素加入“较大”的区域。

text.en: Maintenance when A[j] <= p: after i increases and the swap, the small item is in region (a) and the old first item of region (b) moves to position j (and the empty-region case is covered).
text.zh: 当 A[j] <= p 时的保持：i 增加并交换之后，小的元素进入区域 (a)，区域 (b) 原来的第一个元素移到位置 j（并且覆盖了区域为空的情形）。

text.en: Termination: uses the invariant at j = hi and the final swap to show the claim for q = i + 1.
text.zh: 终止：利用 j = hi 时的不变式和最后一次交换，证明 q = i + 1 满足结论。

mistakes.en: Stating a vague invariant such as "the array is partly sorted" with no index ranges, which cannot be checked.
mistakes.zh: 写出“数组已部分排序”这样含糊的不变式，没有下标范围，无法检验。

mistakes.en: Forgetting that the "greater" region can be empty, so A[i+1] can be A[j] itself.
mistakes.zh: 忘了“较大”的区域可以是空的，这时 A[i+1] 就是 A[j] 本身。

mistakes.en: Skipping the final swap in the termination step, so the position of the pivot is never shown.
mistakes.zh: 终止步骤里省略了最后一次交换，于是枢轴的位置没有被证明。

mistakes.en: Mixing up the two sides: items equal to the pivot go to the left side here, and only strictly greater items go to the right side.
mistakes.zh: 把两侧弄混：这里与枢轴相等的元素放在左边，只有严格大于枢轴的元素才在右边。

mistakes.en: Proving only that the output is a permutation of the input, which does not show the partition property.
mistakes.zh: 只证明输出是输入的一个排列，这并不能说明划分性质。

questions.verify_code:
import random
random.seed(6)

def partition(A, lo, hi):
    pivot = A[hi]
    i = lo - 1
    for j in range(lo, hi):
        # the loop invariant, checked at the start of every iteration
        assert all(A[t] <= pivot for t in range(lo, i + 1))
        assert all(A[t] > pivot for t in range(i + 1, j))
        assert A[hi] == pivot
        if A[j] <= pivot:
            i += 1
            A[i], A[j] = A[j], A[i]
    A[i + 1], A[hi] = A[hi], A[i + 1]
    return i + 1

cases = 0
for _ in range(1000):
    a = [random.randint(0, 6) for _ in range(random.randint(1, 10))]
    b = a[:]
    q = partition(b, 0, len(b) - 1)
    assert sorted(a) == sorted(b)
    assert all(x <= b[q] for x in b[:q]) and all(x > b[q] for x in b[q + 1:])
    cases += 1
print('ok', cases)

title.en: Recursion tree level by level
title.zh: 逐层看递归树

prompt.en:
The function `work(n)` makes three recursive calls on half the size. A call with `n > 1` does `n` units of its own work (not counting its children). A call with `n <= 1` is a leaf and does 1 unit.

Start with `work(16)`. For each level of the recursion tree (level 0 is the first call), write the number of calls at that level, the value of `n` in each of those calls, and the total units of own work done by all calls at that level. The last row is the total over all levels: write the total number of calls and the total work, and `-` for the size. The first row is filled in.
prompt.zh:
函数 `work(n)` 会对规模减半的问题做三次递归调用。`n > 1` 的调用自己做 `n` 个单位的工作（不含子调用）；`n <= 1` 的调用是叶子，做 1 个单位的工作。

从 `work(16)` 开始。对递归树的每一层（第 0 层是最初的那次调用），请写出该层的调用次数、这些调用中 `n` 的值，以及该层所有调用自己做的工作总量。最后一行是所有层的合计：写出调用总次数和工作总量，规模一栏写 `-`。第一行已经填好。

solution.en:
Level 0 is the single call work(16): it does 16 units. Each call splits into 3 calls of half the size, so the number of calls triples and n halves: level 1 has 3 calls with n = 8 (3 x 8 = 24 units), level 2 has 9 calls with n = 4 (36 units), level 3 has 27 calls with n = 2 (54 units).

At level 4, n = 1, so these 81 calls are leaves that do 1 unit each: 81 units.

The totals are 1 + 3 + 9 + 27 + 81 = 121 calls and 16 + 24 + 36 + 54 + 81 = 211 units. The work per level grows from level to level (16, 24, 36, 54, 81, each 1.5 times the one before), because the calls triple while the sizes only halve. So the bottom level dominates. This is the pattern of T(n) = 3T(n/2) + n, whose solution is of order n^(log2 3), the same shape as Karatsuba multiplication.
solution.zh:
第 0 层是唯一的一次调用 work(16)：它做 16 个单位的工作。每次调用拆成 3 次规模减半的调用，所以调用次数翻三倍而 n 减半：第 1 层有 3 次调用，n = 8（3 × 8 = 24 个单位）；第 2 层有 9 次调用，n = 4（36 个单位）；第 3 层有 27 次调用，n = 2（54 个单位）。

第 4 层 n = 1，这 81 次调用都是叶子，每次做 1 个单位：共 81 个单位。

合计是 1 + 3 + 9 + 27 + 81 = 121 次调用，以及 16 + 24 + 36 + 54 + 81 = 211 个单位的工作。每层的工作量逐层增大（16、24、36、54、81，每层是前一层的 1.5 倍），因为调用次数翻三倍而规模只减半，所以最底层起决定作用。这就是 T(n) = 3T(n/2) + n 的模式，它的解的量级是 n^(log2 3)，与 Karatsuba 乘法的形状相同。

title.en: Master theorem, equal case
title.zh: 主定理：相等的情形

prompt.en:
An algorithm splits a problem of size n into 4 subproblems of size n/2. Solving them recursively and then combining the answers takes Θ(n²) steps.

So the running time obeys T(n) = 4T(n/2) + Θ(n²). Which running time follows?
prompt.zh:
一个算法把规模为 n 的问题拆成 4 个规模为 n/2 的子问题。递归求解之后合并答案需要 Θ(n²) 步。

所以运行时间满足 T(n) = 4T(n/2) + Θ(n²)。下面哪个运行时间是对的？

text.en: Θ(n²)
text.zh: Θ(n²)

why.en: This would be the answer if the combining work were smaller than n². Here the combining work equals the n^(log2 4) = n² growth of the leaves, so every level contributes the same amount.
why.zh: 如果合并的工作量比 n² 小，这就是答案。可这里合并的工作量等于叶子增长的 n^(log2 4) = n²，所以每一层贡献的量相同。

text.en: Θ(n² log n)
text.zh: Θ(n² log n)

why.en: Here a = 4 and b = 2, so n^(log_b a) = n². The local work Θ(n²) matches it. Each of the about log2 n levels costs Θ(n²), so the total is Θ(n² log n).
why.zh: 这里 a = 4、b = 2，所以 n^(log_b a) = n²，局部工作量 Θ(n²) 与它同阶。大约 log2 n 层，每层花费 Θ(n²)，总共 Θ(n² log n)。

text.en: Θ(n³)
text.zh: Θ(n³)

why.en: This mixes up the exponent. log2 4 is 2, not 3.
why.zh: 这是把指数弄错了。log2 4 等于 2，不是 3。

text.en: Θ(n log n)
text.zh: Θ(n log n)

why.en: That is the answer for T(n) = 2T(n/2) + Θ(n), the merge sort recurrence, not this one.
why.zh: 这是 T(n) = 2T(n/2) + Θ(n)（归并排序的递推式）的答案，不是这一题的。
